facts.fact: The digital ministry's portal reports that a strategic seminar on 5-6 February 2026, under the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Ministry of Digital Affairs, marked a key step in drawing up Benin's digital strategy to 2031, with the drafting led by Deloitte.
facts.system: stratégie numérique du Bénin à l'horizon 2031

facts.fact: The 5-6 February 2026 seminar brought public sector, private operators and technical partners together to define a vision, orientations and priority initiatives for the next five years of the 2031 digital strategy.
